Find public data and build a business dashboard
A commenter used Claude Code to prototype a business dashboard and to gather public data into a folder instead of searching manually.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
A commenter said they used Claude Code to prototype a business dashboard and have it find public data for them. Instead of searching manually, they had Claude do the work and drop the results into a folder, which led them toward building their own small agents and downloaders rather than clicking around Google or using someone else’s app.
How it went
They describe it as good for coming up with something innovative and fresh, and more satisfying than manual searching. They do not give metrics, examples of the data sources, or any concrete result from the dashboard itself.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the source is very thin: it gives no steps, tools, costs, or timing beyond using Claude Code to place found data into a folder.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Find public data sources relevant to [my business or industry], such as [specific metrics], and download what you can into a folder called [folder name]. Then build a simple dashboard prototype from that data showing [key metrics]. You're done when I can open the dashboard locally and a README lists each data source and its URL.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1m9565z/does_anyone_use_claude_code_for_noncoding_use
